The rankings are based on net approval — the percentage approving minus the percentage disapproving — among registered voters surveyed from April 1 through June 30. Morning Consult surveyed 9,572 New Jersey voters, with a one-point margin of error. [...] Gov. Mikie Sherrill is among the nation’s most popular governors, while President Donald Trump remains deeply unpopular in New Jersey and both of the state’s Democratic U.S. senators hold solid approval ratings, according to a new Morning Consult poll.

Sherrill has a 55%-30% approval rating, giving her a net approval of +25 during her first quarter in Morning Consult’s gubernatorial tracking.
results.title: Sherrill among nation’s most popular governors as Trump sinks in New Jersey, poll says
